title: Assertion
description: A claim the plan depends on being true. Cross-cutting rather than stage-owned (#25), so no x-stage. ⚠️ THIS SCHEMA DELIBERATELY HAS NO `confidence` AND NO `verdict` FIELD (#96). Both are derived from this artifact plus its evidence graph by lib/effective-assertion.mjs, and storing either would be a second copy of a value the graph already determines — the copy that goes stale silently, and the one a reader trusts.

allOf.$comment: Same invariant decision carries, and nested inside allOf per #82. A superseded assertion must name its successor, or the record is a dead end that looks like history.

statement.description: The claim, stated so that it could be shown false. Same field name as requirement.statement and decision.statement: the payload field is `statement` in every type that has one (#82).

loadBearing.description: Whether the plan changes if this claim is false. Drives #57's threshold: a load-bearing claim must reach its rung before anything may rest on it, and a non-load-bearing one need not.

targetEnvironment.description: What the claim is asserted ABOUT. This is the other half of #96's applicability filter — evidence is applicable when its observed environment matches these facts, and `environment-matched` (#42 rung 4) means exactly that it did. ⚠️ AMENDED 2026-08-22 (#134): isolation is one of these dimensions rather than a separate ceiling, via `requiresIsolation`.

facts.description: The dimensions this claim turns on. Compared key-by-key against evidence.environment.facts; a key absent from the evidence is not a match, and is not a mismatch either — it is unknown, and unknown does not reach rung 4.

requiresIsolation.description: Isolation properties this claim DEPENDS ON, compared claim-relatively against evidence.environment.isolationBoundary (#134). Required and matched -> may reach rung 4. Required but absent (e.g. a host run, which claims no isolation) -> unknown, capped below rung 4. Required and explicitly NOT claimed by the run -> the evidence does not apply at all. ⚠️ Absent or empty means this claim does not turn on isolation, and NO penalty follows: a claim that never asked about containment is not weakened for failing to have it. ⚠️ This is why there is no tier-to-confidence ceiling. Sandbox tier is a PERMISSION and an execution boundary, not an epistemic rank: a host run can legitimately reach `environment-matched` for a claim about that host, and tier 1 cannot lift an OS-containment claim merely because a virtual environment existed.

supportedBy.description: Evidence bearing IN FAVOUR of the claim. Split from refutedBy because polarity is intrinsic where evidence bears on a claim's truth (#82's naming rule) — and because a single evidencedBy list would make `contested` (#96) underivable.

refutedBy.description: Evidence bearing AGAINST the claim. Its existence is the whole reason a rung alone is ambiguous: `experimentally-validated` is compatible with the claim being false.

arisesFrom.description: What raised this claim — the requirement, decision or research finding that needed it to be true.

tags.description: Changing tags never invalidates an approval (#103) — the clear advisory case, declared rather than inferred.

supersededBy.description: The assertion(s) that replaced this one — typically properly-scoped successors after an under-scoped claim was split.

x-derivedRelations.description: #96. `verdict` and `confidence` are NOT stored here. lib/effective-assertion.mjs computes both from this artifact, its supportedBy/refutedBy evidence, and each evidence record's environment, observedAt, lifecycle and supersededBy. The handoff may materialise the rung, labelled derived rather than authoritative.
x-derivedRelations.verdict: derived — unresolved | supported | refuted | contested, after applicability filtering

x-crossCutting.description: #25: validation is cross-cutting, so no stage in stages/ claims assertion and there is no x-stage. stages/03-discovery lists it as a producesCandidate (#92), which is a claim nobody has settled and which the gate does not enforce.

x-unresolvableTraceTargets.description: #75: research-finding and question are activated on this project but not yet implemented; scope for links to dangle until they are.
